description: AI Agents (inside one system): Use to find tasks across a whole AI agent's system, such as every open task or what one user still has to do. Not for the tasks of one record you already know (use list_related_records). Where a task names the contact it is on, update_task needs that contact.

contacts.description: Only the tasks on these contacts, by their ids.

cursor.description: The cursor of the previous answer, to read the next page.

done.description: True for finished tasks only, false for open tasks only; both when left out.

limit.description: How many to return per page, 1 to 100.

system.description: Which AI agent: the system's id from get_ai_agents_info, or the name of the system or its connection. Ask the person which AI agent they mean unless they named it in this conversation; never pick one yourself.

text.description: Words the task has to hold.

users.description: Only the tasks of these users, by the ids describe_record_type gives with include users.

name: search_tasks
title: Search tasks across all records
